title: Linear programming certificates for dimension bounds of hyperbolic Coxeter polytopes
abstract: We use linear programming to derive upper bounds for the dimension of hyperbolic Coxeter polytopes from local geometric and arithmetic estimates. Rational certificates give the bounds $57$ for finite-volume polytopes, $17$ for compact polytopes, and $15$ for compact arithmetic polytopes. In the finite-volume case, the certificate is a weight function on incidences between vertices and two-dimensional faces. In the compact cases, the inequalities concern squared norms of orthogonal projections of a fixed tangent vector at a vertex farthest from an interior point. We give a common formulation of these linear programs, prove monotonicity in the dimension threshold, and describe the exact verification of the certificates. The local estimates are taken from the companion geometric proofs.
